svg.aria-label: Software Development Engineer 3 at OneCX, Apr 2025 to Present. Sole backend owner of a multiplayer language-learning platform, built as a modular NestJS service. Elasticsearch + Redis search over ~12M entries with 40% lower latency. BullMQ workers took power-ups off the request path: ~35% faster APIs. Socket.IO gateway for live game state and matchmaking, with one consistent ${event}:error contract. Zero-downtime TypeORM migrations on PostgreSQL: nullable → backfill → constrain. Prometheus + Grafana cut incident detection time by 50%; JWT, rate limiting, field-level encryption. Bulk email service reaching 250K recipients in under 10 minutes.
